Rechecked the already staged Uzbekistan substation programme, Japan/World Bank DRIVE energy financing, OPEC December output requirements and US Treasury funding conditions. No independently evidenced new structural candidate distinct from prior staging was established; no candidate invented.

Prior Uzbekistan and DRIVE financing approvals do not establish disbursement, commissioning or measured productivity gains.
No newly dated verified physical project completion, binding new capital commitment or logistics bottleneck sufficient for a distinct candidate.
